title: Marco Rubio's attempt to approach Harrington

tellings.quote: because five or 6 years ago, Marco Rubio tried to approach him and that he got shut down.

plain: About five or six years ago, around 2020, the US senator Marco Rubio is said to have tried to approach a government official named John S. Herrington about UFO matters and to have been shut down. Brent Friedman, a guest on the show, tells it as something passed along to him, with the whistleblower David Grusch among those he cites, and it would suggest that even a senior senator could not get answers.
